info.description: Approved service and box ice quantity through the elapsed packing-to-arrival hours, including delay allowance. Missing coverage makes that box unavailable.

DryIceMultiplier.description: Legacy draft field retained for protected data review. Clear it after reviewing the explicit service, box and blocks-per-box values; enabled publication rejects a legacy multiplier so older seasonal consumers cannot misread the units.

DryIceBlocksPerBox.description: Approved number of blocks in one physical box. Fractions require explicit operating approval. Ice pounds are block count times block weight, subject to the separate minimum.
